UNCERTAIN because cross-pair PSNR is low (pair1 22.32 dB with signal MISMATCH variance_ratio 79%; pair2 20.48 dB) while pair1 variance_ratio is matched by the RGB-shift family (RGB:4 mean_shift diff 0.0314) - supports do not share a single well-fitting parameter set (per-pair severity or unmodeled tone-curve component), so exact-match confidence is limited. Stopped at 24 test_candidate calls (<=25 budget), 3 rounds.
